leadText:
Timothy (Japanese: ヒロキ Hiroki) is a character of the day who appeared in The Dunsparce Deception.

Timothy was able to capture a during a massive emergence of the Land Snake Pokémon. He invited several children to a local playground and challenged Bucky, who was away during the swarm event, and his to compete in a race against all of the other children's Dunsparce. However, Caterpie struggled against the Dunsparce and Timothy had his Pokémon fly over one of the obstacles. After Caterpie fell, Bucky took himself out of the race, while a girl scolded Timothy for humiliating him.

Timothy and the other children went to watch 's " versus Dunsparce" performance, though they were left disappointed by the costumes and acting. After the play was over, Jessie announced that the children could trade their Dunsparce for a Moltres. Timothy was first in line, and the other children followed suit, completely unaware that it was a scheme by Team Rocket to steal all of their Pokémon. Bucky, , and stumbled upon the crying children, who revealed that they had been conned and received fake s after trading away their Dunsparce.

After the situation was resolved and Bucky caught his own Dunsparce, he, Timothy, and the other children were able to play together.
